summary: Created TestDriver_Area_WizardTest_Preselection extending Application_Admin_Area_Mode with URL name 'preselection', implementing _handleActions() that reads ?country=<ISO>, validates via Application_Countries::isoExists(), builds a WizardConfigurator session preselecting the country_id on the Countries step, then redirects to the wizard. Falls through to _renderContent() with usage instructions when no valid country param is present.

comments.note: TestDriver_Area_WizardTest_Wizard_Step_Countries._process() references 'country_id' as a raw string literal in setData() and getDefaultData() — these could now be replaced with the new VALUE_COUNTRY_ID constant for consistency, but that change is outside the scope of this WP.

TestDriver_Area_WizardTest_Wizard.changeCountry() also uses the raw string 'country_id' in setWizardSetting(). With VALUE_COUNTRY_ID now defined on the step class, this could be DRY'd up in a future pass.

The Preselection mode's _renderContent() casts the renderer to string with (string) to satisfy the return type declared as string. The renderer's __toString / Renderable chain works correctly, but if the return type is later tightened to UI_Themes_Theme_ContentRenderer callers should return the renderer directly.

AC4: Mode screen renders navigation title, page title, and isUserAllowed=true; _renderContent() provides usage instructions with ?country= examples.

summary: WP-004 code review PASSED. Both files (Preselection.php and Step/Countries.php) are clean, well-structured, and idiomatic for this codebase.

Preselection.php: Architecture is correct — _handleActions() returns true to fall through to _renderContent() when no valid country param is present, matching the Application_Admin_Area_Mode contract. The guard-clause structure (empty ISO check → isoExists() check → redirect) is readable and follows the single-exit-per-concern principle. The WizardConfigurator is instantiated only after all validation passes, which is the right order.
The REQUEST_PARAM_COUNTRY constant on the class is a good DRY practice — it makes the param name refactorable in one place and is self-documenting at the call site.

Step/Countries.php: VALUE_COUNTRY_ID = 'country_id' is correctly typed as public const string, documented with a @see cross-reference to both consumers (Preselection and WizardConfigurator), and scoped public so external callers can reference it without magic strings.

Three pre-existing string literals ('country_id' in _process(), getDefaultData(), and Wizard.php changeCountry()) were noted by Developer and QA — these are outside WP-004 scope and tracked as low-priority debt, not blocking issues.
The (string) cast on the renderer in _renderContent() is the established pattern in this codebase for satisfying string return types — no issue.

_renderContent() content is purely a dev/test tool, so the hard-coded ISO examples (GB, DE, MX) are appropriate — they match exactly the countries seeded by the Wizard class, creating a coherent self-contained test screen.
No blocking issues found. No Fix-Forward changes needed. Documentation gaps noted below for the Documentation agent.
